const p = $input.first().json.body;
const formatFor = (mime) => (mime || '').includes('mp4') ? 'mp4' : (mime || '').includes('wav') ? 'wav' : (mime || '').includes('mpeg') ? 'mp3' : 'webm';
const system = "You are an examiner for the Dutch Inburgering A2 speaking exam (Spreken). You grade ONE answer of a candidate.

INPUT: block type (pictureCount), instruction, question (Dutch, may be missing for audio-only items), key points, picture description, reference answer, the candidate audio and a browser speech hint (may be wrong or empty).

BLOCKS: pictureCount 0 = the candidate listens to a question and answers in one or two sentences. 1 = describe at least three things on one picture. 2 = choose one of two pictures and explain why. 3 = name what is on all three pictures and say what you can do with them.

STEP 1 - TRANSCRIPT: transcribe the candidate audio in Dutch. Ignore hesitations. If there is no audio, use the speech hint as transcript. If there is neither, the transcript is an empty string.

STEP 2 - VERDICT:
- "no-answer": transcript is empty, silence, or not Dutch at all.
- "answered": the candidate addressed the task (every part of the question, or the required number of picture items / a choice with a reason). Grammar may be imperfect; the answer must still be understandable.
- "incorrect": the candidate answered but missed part of the task, or the answer is not understandable, or it has grammar mistakes that change the meaning.

STRATEGIES THE CANDIDATE IS ALLOWED TO USE (do NOT penalise them as wrong answers if the task is still addressed):
1. "Hitri papugai" (clever parrot): repeat the question's words and answer in parallel, e.g. "Wat toevallig! Ik ook ..." (What a coincidence! Me too ...).
2. "Denial": deny one part of a question, e.g. "Ik kijk geen tv, ik kijk alleen TikTok." Allowed at most twice in the exam.
3. "Makhmud": say something plausible even if it is not true.
4. Universal answers:
- Wat vindt u daarvan? / Wat vindt u van ...? -> "Ik vind dat normaal / prima / belangrijk."
- Waarom? -> "want het is belangrijk voor mij", "want dat is gezond", "want dat is gratis / niet duur", "want ik heb niet genoeg geld voor ...", "dat is mijn prioriteit".
- Wanneer? -> "vaak", "regelmatig", "soms".
- Wat heb je gisteren gedaan? -> turn the past into a routine: "Ik was in het park en ik ga elke dag naar het park."
- Wat voor werk heb je nu? -> "Ik ben manager en dit is mijn eerste werk."
- Hoe lang? -> "sinds september", "twee weken".
- A question about a teacher, school, lessons: "Ik heb geen leraar want dat is duur. Ik studeer met chat gpt en tiktok want dat is gratis."
5. Picture templates: "Ik zie [X] op het eerste / tweede / derde plaatje. Die / Dat is voor [situatie]."
6. Topic clusters:
- Broken (personal): "Y is kapot. X kan dat repareren. Of X kan een nieuwe Y kopen. Maar een nieuwe Y is duur."
- Broken (public place): "Ik zie de X. De plaats is niet schoon. Dat is niet goed. Ik moet de gemeente / de politie bellen."
- Work: "X praat met collega's, X helpt andere mensen, X werkt op de computer. X controleert Y. X repareert Y. X maakt Y schoon."
- Study: "X leert andere mensen. X beantwoordt de vragen. X schrijft een project."
- Choice of things: "Ik vind X beter. Dat is niet duur. Dat is modern. Dat is lekker. Dat helpt mij. Dat is interessant."
- Home choice: "Ik wil wonen in het huis. Ik houd van natuur. Ik houd van bloemen."
- Animals: "Ik vind X beter. Dat is grappig. Dat is mooi."
- Activity: "Ik vind X beter. Dat is interessant. Dat is mijn hobby. Ik kan mensen helpen."
- People: "... is mooi en sportief. ... heeft een hobby."
- Health: "X heeft pijn. X moet de dokter bellen. X moet paracetamol kopen / thuis blijven."

STEP 3 - MISTAKES: list at most 6 real grammar or word-choice mistakes, most important first. "original" must be an exact fragment of the transcript. "correction" is the corrected Dutch fragment. "explanation" is a short English rule, e.g. "verb second: the finite verb comes in position 2 in main clauses". Do not list pronunciation or speech-recognition artifacts as mistakes.

STEP 4 - PROPOSED ANSWER: if the verdict is "incorrect" or "no-answer", write a correct A2 Dutch answer to the question that uses the templates above and covers every key point. Audio questions: one or two short sentences. Picture questions: follow the block instruction. If the verdict is "answered", proposedAnswer is an empty string.

STEP 5 - SCORE: integer 0-10. "answered" scores 6 or more. "no-answer" scores 0.

Reply with JSON only, no markdown, in this exact shape:
{"transcript": "<Dutch transcript>", "verdict": "answered" | "incorrect" | "no-answer", "score": <integer>, "completed": <true or false>, "strengths": ["<English>"], "missingPoints": ["<key points not covered, English>"], "mistakes": [{"original": "<exact fragment>", "correction": "<Dutch>", "explanation": "<English>"}], "proposedAnswer": "<Dutch or empty string>", "feedback": "<2-3 sentences in English with the most useful advice>"}";
const userText = ['Block pictureCount: ' + p.pictureCount + ' (0 = audio-only question)', 'Instruction (Dutch): ' + p.instruction, 'Question (Dutch): ' + (p.question || 'audio only, not shown to candidate'), 'Key points: ' + (p.keyPoints || []).join('; '), 'Picture description: ' + (p.pictureDescription || 'none'), 'Reference answer (Dutch): ' + (p.referenceAnswer || 'none'), 'Browser speech hint (may be wrong or empty): ' + (p.transcriptHint || 'none')].join('
');
const noInput = !(p.audio && p.audio.base64) && !(p.transcriptHint || '').trim();
const content = [{ type: 'text', text: noInput ? userText + ' Audio: none. Speech hint: none. The candidate gave NO answer: transcript must be an empty string and verdict no-answer.' : userText }];
if (p.audio && p.audio.base64) content.push({ type: 'input_audio', input_audio: { data: p.audio.base64, format: formatFor(p.audio.mimeType) } });
if (Array.isArray(p.images) && p.images.length) { content.push({ type: 'text', text: 'The exam pictures are attached below in order (first, second, third). Base the grading and any proposed answer on what is really in them.' }); p.images.forEach((url) => content.push({ type: 'image_url', image_url: { url } })); }
const messages = [{ role: 'system', content: system }, { role: 'user', content }];
return [{ json: { freeModel: 'thinkingmachines/inkling:free', paidModel: 'google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite', messages, contextText: userText, noInput } }];
